name: LiveBench
description: A dynamic benchmark with monthly-refreshed questions sourced from recent math competitions, arXiv papers, and news articles. Contains 18 tasks across 6 categories: reasoning, math, coding, language, data analysis, and instruction following. All scoring is fully automated without LLM judges. Achieves 0.88–0.91 Spearman correlation with Chatbot Arena Elo ratings.
typical_sota_score: <70% (top models as of early 2026; consistently non-saturated due to monthly refresh)
reputation: Accepted at ICLR 2025 spotlight; one of the most recommended contamination-resistant benchmarks; endorsed by leading researchers for tracking real progress; backed by Abacus.AI with academic collaborators
notes: Questions are retired after 6 months and replaced with fresh ones, making contamination nearly impossible. No LLM-as-judge reduces evaluation bias. High correlation with Chatbot Arena (0.88–0.91 Spearman) validates its real-world relevance. Accepted as ICLR 2025 spotlight paper. Daily/weekly adoption on major leaderboards. Represents the future direction of contamination-resistant evaluation.
